tasks.CheckConditions: Verify if the formulated number satisfies all the given conditions.
tasks.DefineVariables: Define the three digits of the number as variables.
tasks.FormulateNumber: Formulate the original number from the solved digits.
tasks.SetUpEquations: Set up a system of equations based on the given conditions.
tasks.SolveSystemOfEquations: Solve the system of equations to find the values of the digits.
